title: Add a group of contacts to a workflow
blurb: Drop a list of people into an automated follow-up sequence.

steps.title: Filter to the right people
steps.body: Use a smart list or **Advanced Filters** to show only the people who should go into the workflow.

steps.title: Select them
steps.body: Tick the contacts, or the top box for everyone shown.

steps.title: Choose the automation option
steps.body: In the toolbar, click the automation icon to add them to a workflow.

steps.title: Pick the workflow
steps.body: Give the job a name, choose **Workflow** as the type, then pick your workflow. It must be published to show up.

steps.title: Choose the timing
steps.body: Enrol them all at once, at a scheduled time, or in drip mode a batch at a time. Confirm to start.
steps.tip: Track the job under the **Bulk Actions** tab.
